units.title: FOIA request/release log normalization
units.mappingEvidence: CSV/TSV/XLSX log normalization with row provenance, confidence and failed-row queue merged via #71 (fixtures). PDF/scanned logs and real official logs pending. #75 exports rows and per agency/year coverage and routes SFL fulfilled logs into FC-03. #91 adds published-log scraping (registry of 50 unverified official log pages), PDF/XLS parsing, pages_released, and the closed-request master list with first-party exclusion (fixtures; no real log ingested yet).

units.title: Third-party released FOIA records and MuckRock integration
units.mappingEvidence: MuckRock adapter against recorded-shape fixtures (#73, inert). Other third-party archives, live sample and binary dedupe pending. Request-listing mode by date window (MuckRock API v2, token-gated, no requester identity) with /requests and /api/v1/requests (#84); live probe: API BLOCKED by Cloudflare 403 from CI runners, token not yet provided. #91 matches closed requests to MuckRock tracking ids and DocumentCloud search (fixtures).

units.title: Historical and deep-archive backfill
units.mappingEvidence: Date-window backfill plans, oldest-first missed-period queue, verified window spans, per-source release windows (#78, fixtures). Depends on FC-04; live backfill pending. Published-date window crawl (--since-days, dispatch inputs) and bounded live probe (#82); live probe found no detectable published dates on 8 reached listing pages. Release-date sources (page > Last-Modified > PDF metadata) and newly-found-after-baseline window downloads (#86); live probe: 223 of 226 links carried Last-Modified. Page-level baselines remove false newly-found from deeper traversal; dynamic Last-Modified ignored; live probe 236/366 sources reached, 9,796 links, 4,137 dated, ~1.35 GB/week (7-day Content-Length estimate) (#88).

units.title: Adaptive adapters for API and dynamic portals
units.mappingEvidence: Site-type detection, challenge/403 -> BLOCKED, sitemap-tree and JSON listing adapters (#78, fixtures). Audited live field sample pending. RSS/Atom feed autodiscovery, FBI Vault Recently-added feed (Plone files), host-parallel engine (#88).

units.title: Content-type completeness and enrichment
